zh-CN.name: CAD 制图
zh-CN.description: 使用 cad_inspect / cad_draw / cad_verify 将空间分析结果转换为可检查、可追溯的 2D DXF 图纸。
features: GeoJSON 转 DXF，显式声明单位与坐标变换
查询、按 revision 编辑并原子提交 DXF
只读 Canvas 查看图纸并共享图层/实体上下文
生成 PNG/PDF 预览并重新打开校验

en-US.name: CAD Drawing
en-US.description: Uses cad_inspect / cad_draw / cad_verify to turn spatial analysis into inspectable, revisioned 2D DXF drawings.
features: GeoJSON to DXF with explicit units and coordinate transform
Inspect, edit by revision and atomically commit DXF
Read-only Canvas with layer/entity context sharing
Renders PNG/PDF previews and reopens the file for verification
